title: Position and lock 96-well PCR cooler rack on magnetic separation stand
instruction: Transfer the 96-well PCR cooler rack onto the magnetic separation stand and engage the slide lock bar.
context: Biological, chemical, pharmaceutical, and clinical laboratory personnel (>690,000 professional laboratory workforce, including BLS SOC 29-2010, 29-2012, 19-4021, 19-4031, 19-1099) routinely perform solid-phase reversible immobilization (SPRI) magnetic bead cleanup protocols during high-throughput next-generation sequencing (NGS) library construction and viral nucleic acid extraction. Reaction mixtures held in chilled 96-well skirted PCR cooler racks are transferred onto high-gradient neodymium magnetic separation stands to pellet paramagnetic beads against well walls. A sliding mechanical lock bar is engaged over the skirt flange to rigidly clamp the plate against strong magnetic pull-down forces, preventing plate displacement or misalignment during automated liquid washing steps.
setup: A benchtop workstation with a silicone cleanroom staging mat at (0.260, 0.200, 0.748) m holding a chilled cobalt blue 96-well skirted PCR cooler rack (127.8 x 85.5 x 28.0 mm, 110 g) centered at (0.260, 0.200, 0.7665) m. At (0.280, -0.040, 0.748) m sits a precision anodized aluminum 96-well neodymium magnetic bead separation stand (145 x 105 x 35 mm) with recessed registration nest (nest floor at Z = 0.7705 m; seated rack center at Z = 0.7845 m) and a mechanical sliding lock bar with knurled handle tab (prismatic slider along Y, travel 20 mm, minimum engagement threshold >= 8.0 mm).
scoring: Stage progression: 0.10 - 0.39: cooler rack lifted vertically clear of staging mat (Z >= 0.7815 m, lift >= 15 mm) and transferring toward magnetic stand; 0.40: cooler rack seated flush in magnetic registration nest (|dx| <= 20 mm, |dy| <= 20 mm, |dz| <= 18 mm); 0.40 - 0.69: sliding lock bar advancing along +Y toward full engagement (0.0 to 8.0 mm travel); 0.70 - 1.00: cooler rack currently seated flush in nest, slide lock bar currently engaged (travel >= 8.0 mm), and both robot arms retracted clear (> 50 mm clearance) for a continuous 20-step (1.0 s at 20 Hz) stillness hold. Zero permanent positive latching: dislodging rack or retracting lock bar immediately drops score.
reset_notes: Place the 96-well PCR cooler rack flat on the staging mat at (0.260, 0.200, 0.7665) m. Retract the magnetic stand slide lock bar fully to q = 0.0 mm along Y. Release both robotic manipulators and restore them to standard bimanual park configurations.
fidelity: 100% genuine dynamic contact bodies via PhysX. Authentic ANSI/SLAS 1-2004 96-well microplate footprint and standard laboratory apparatus dimensions. USD prismatic slider joint with authentic travel limits (0 to 20 mm) and Coulomb friction. Zero synthetic pose overwrites (write_root_pose_to_sim) or artificial welds.
